name: diskwala-engine
description: Real-headless-Chrome (CDP) resolver for diskwala.net links, used by diskwala.py's _resolve_diskwala_browser_engine() as a spawned subprocess. Drives the actual diskwala.net web player (types the link into its own input, clicks its own 'Get' button, sniffs the /web/api/status network response) instead of replicating its API calls directly — sidesteps Cloudflare entirely since it IS a real browser, no TLS/cookie impersonation needed.
